scope: AES plans must declare whether work runs a model, agent or pipeline and, if so, carry a trace_review evidence requirement with a structured review record

fact_evidence.existing_implementation_obstacle: Nothing blocks the change; planning.py, records.py and evidence.py take a new field and a new evidence kind directly.
fact_evidence.reproduced_failure: 2026-10-06 vision milestone 4: run 4 of the interview coder (trace qualitative_coding/project/0cbd41e8, calls_2026-10-06.jsonl) mislabelled workplace complaints OUTCOME_NO_GAIN through two amendments; reviews read only its output; the cause was visible only in the unread trace.
fact_evidence.identified_fix: Every AES proposal declares trace_review; traced work must carry a trace_review evidence requirement whose observation holds a structured review record. Implemented and tested in tests/greenfield/test_trace_review.py.
fact_evidence.concurrent_writers: Claims checked 2026-10-07: the aes-planning rollout claim writes commit_rule.py, hooks.py and .aes/commit_rule.yaml, none of the files this plan changes; claim trace-review-in-plans holds these paths.
fact_evidence.machine_consumed_planning_handoff: No work graph is handed to another machine; the output is code, tests and a protocol section.
fact_evidence.shared_contract_mutation: Adds a required proposal field and an evidence kind with an observation record, shared by every AES-governed repository.
fact_evidence.persistent_migration: No data migration; plans accepted earlier still load because the field is optional when loading.
fact_evidence.governed_registry: Changes AES canonical's governed roots, so the AES target and an accepted plan are required.
fact_evidence.consequential_external_mutation: Nothing is sent or deployed outside the repository.
fact_evidence.answer_only: Brian asked for the change: 'we need aes plans to require trace reviews as part of its planning' (2026-10-07).
fact_evidence.continuity_beyond_session: One session lands it in one pull request.
fact_evidence.one_writer: This session is the only writer of these files (claim trace-review-in-plans).
fact_evidence.reversible: A git revert restores the previous validator; no records are rewritten.
fact_evidence.boundary_known: The boundary is AES's proposal validation and observation loading, read in full before the change.

rationale: One writer, a reproduced failure and an identified, reversible fix to a shared contract inside a governed registry.
